## Design Constraint Summary

**Total Design Constraints: 18 (DC-01–DC-18)**

| Group | DC IDs | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| Execution environment | DC-01 | Claude Code CLI only |
| Tool allowlist | DC-02 | Agent tools permitted list |
| Model assignment | DC-03 | Fixed model per role |
| Sub-agent depth | DC-04 | Max depth 2 |
| Output format | DC-05, DC-06 | Markdown + Mermaid; source code files |
| File path / storage | DC-07, DC-08 | projects/ root only; forward-slash paths |
| No external APIs | DC-09 | Anthropic API only |
| Credential security | DC-10 | No hardcoded secrets |
| Cross-platform | DC-11, DC-12 | Win/Mac/Linux equivalence |
| Coding standards | DC-13–DC-17 | English imperatives, required headings, zero-padded IDs, ATX headings |
| No git operations | DC-18 | No git commands in skill instructions |
